technical.mission_statement: Identify external developments capable of materially affecting operational resilience, critical/important services, cybersecurity, technology infrastructure, major third-party dependencies, telecommunications, banking/financial services resilience, business continuity, crisis preparedness, regulatory resilience obligations, Australian operating conditions, and relevant regional/global systemic dependencies.

proximity_tiers.label: New Zealand (where relevant)
examples: NZ telco/banking disruption with trans-Tasman implication

proximity_tiers.label: APAC systemic implications
examples: regional hyperscaler outage affecting APAC region

proximity_tiers.label: Major global dependency
examples: major cyber vulnerability affecting enterprise infrastructure broadly

proximity_tiers.label: Local/human-interest overseas, no systemic link
examples: local emergency reporting overseas with no AU/systemic implication

systemic_value_override.description: An item may bypass low proximity weight if systemic enough. Extends the existing escape-hatch already implemented in intelligence/classification/filter.py's operational-relevance override keywords for non-AU geography filtering.

technical.novelty_note: Novelty is assessed against the dedup/cluster layer (intelligence/classification/deduplicator.py + signal_corroboration), not from this config — no per-category novelty parameters needed here.

actionability_signals.description: Phrases suggesting the item could change monitoring/preparation/response/escalation/a briefing — used as a soft signal into the relevance-gate prompt, not a hard filter.

exclusions.description: Deterministic-filter category exclusions — feeds intelligence/classification/filter.py's existing suppression categories rather than duplicating them; documents what filter.py enforces so it's inspectable outside the code.

health.mission_statement: Identify credible evidence capable of materially changing understanding, decisions, or future exploration across TJR HQ's explicitly monitored health, recovery, neurodivergence, and performance domains.

population_fit_guidance.description: Used by the curation LLM (health_signal_curation.py) to score population match. Guidance text, not a hard filter.
low_fit_examples: paediatric-only findings with no adult-transferability discussion
elderly-only populations for domains where TJR's monitored population is working-age adults

safety_bypass.description: A plausible adverse-event/safety signal on an actively-monitored intervention/exposure must be able to bypass ordinary topic/domain filtering. Behavioural rule for health_signal_curation.py to enforce (already defaults to ESCALATE on ambiguity) — recorded here as documented policy, not new keyword data.
safety_bypass.enforced_in: tools/health-osint/health_signal_curation.py (HealthSignalCurator) — existing ESCALATE-on-ambiguity default already satisfies this.
